plotEn:
The Banquet is a Canadian comedy-drama film, directed by Gloria Ui Young Kim and released in 2026. The film stars Vicki Kim as Sunny, a burned-out advertising executive who is challenged by her mother Young-ja (Park Hye-jin) to take over the family's annual Chuseok dinner, despite barely knowing how to cook any of her mother's traditional recipes, shortly after discovering that her business and personal partner Dean (Austin Ball) is cheating on her.
